Guide to the United States Bureau of Public Roads Records 1915-1961 Overview of the Collection Creator: United States. Bureau of Public Roads Title: United States Bureau of Public Roads Records Dates: 1915-1961 ( inclusive ) Quantity: 14 cubic feet Collection Number: MS281 Summary: The collection contains records relating to highway construction in Idaho. Repository: Idaho State Historical Society Public Archives and Research Library 2205 Old Penitentiary Road Boise, Idaho 83712-8250 208-334-3356 - phone 208-334-3198 - fax www.idahohistory.net Languages: English Sponsor: Funding for encoding this finding aid was provided through a grant awarded by the National Endowment for the Humanities. Content Description Included are project history notebooks, maps, traffic reports and information on Indian Reservation roads. Also, photographic records of projects from all parts of Idaho. Photographs illustrate geography before construction, construction methods, cities and other scenes. Use of the Collection Restrictions on Access : The collection is open for research. Administrative Information Arrangement : Boxes 1-4: Manuals, written reports, projects, reports on Indian Reservation roads.
